data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2016 the syndicate carried gross claims outstanding of GBP 61.371m. Analysis of the gross claims development table shows a deterioration on prior years driven by an increase in the 2014 ultimate from the prior estimate to the current estimate (an adverse movement of c.GBP 6.256m), resulting in a net prior-year strengthening. The report contains no single explicit narrative sentence quantifying a gross prior-year release or strengthening; the figure above is calculated from the gross claims development table.
raw_causal_phrases: Delays can be experienced in the notification and settlement of certain types of claims and therefore, the ultimate cost of these claims cannot be known with certainty at the reporting date.
The directors consider that the provisions for gross claims and related reinsurance recoveries are fairly stated on the basis of the information currently available to them.

The liability is calculated at the reporting date using a range of standard actuarial claim projection techniques, based on empirical data and current assumptions that may include a margin for adverse deviation.
data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development (6.256m) was calculated from the gross claims development table (gross triangle) shown in the Technical Provisions note. No single explicit sentence quantifying a gross prior-year movement was found. All triangle numbers are presented in the accounts in GBP 000 (thousands) and the movement was converted to millions. No RITC adjustment was identified as invalidating the triangle for the 2014 column, but the report does describe reinsurance-to-close / reinsurance close transactions elsewhere which could affect comparability; user should treat the PYD as calculated from the triangle (confidence 0.8). Exact textual description of the prior year movement was not located in the narrative (exact_reserve_text left blank).
